diagnostic_label: At completed daily close forward7 daily ER<=.35 AND >=2 forward EMA34 sign flips; label never a feature
detector_rules: EMA34; ATR EMA14 true range; near<=1ATR; ER7<=.35; slope abs(EMA[t]-EMA[t-3])/ATR<=.35; flips>=2 among7 completed daily sign transitions. All masks enter/exit only after2 consecutive raw states.
split: calibration 2024-09-01..2025-09-01; holdout 2025-09-01..2026-09-01. Calibration TP training excludes horizons crossing split. End limited by dataset or actual native BTC exit.
cost_arithmetic: Fixed entry beta from90 completed daily log returns, opposite SOL notional=BTCnotional/beta. pairgross=signedBTCreturn+oppositeSOLreturn/beta. subtract .0011*(1+1/beta), conservative taker roundtrip BOTH legs. Funding/slippage/marketimpact unknown; not true net lower bound. BTC TP triggers diagnostically change close fractions only, preserve native entry context.
limitations: No counterfactual fills, sizing, margin, cash, equity, TOTAL, ROI or DD computed
Overlapping paths are dependent; hit fractions are descriptive not guarantees
Minute close trigger executable only later; no fill guarantee. Entry close differs from actual native avg fill; context side/time exact
Censored paths counted nonhits in observed hit fraction; native actual exit truncation informative
No high-low ordering used for TP; all MFE/MAE here close-based conservative diagnostics
SOL signals within chop are descriptive context and not substituted native entries
Daily source hashes fresh; minute execution source hashes fresh sequentially; no mark/observer scan
Conditional pair net excludes nonhits and is NOT an unconditional edge estimate
diagnostic_calibration_embargo: Diagnostic forward7 label must end strictly before split; same end7D exclusion on holdout. Daily-only correction; selected unchanged.
minvar_comparison_scope: Only stored30 representative15m native-entry BTC-trigger endpoints; not TP-family distribution or standalone edge. All paired distributions in TP.csv remain factor-neutral.

strongest_candidate.detector: near_slope selected on calibration balanced accuracy; high false alarm rate forbids automatic full coverage purely from this flag
strongest_candidate.coverage: Only compare existing actual remaining BTC and one net SOL position; factor-neutral NB/beta is ceiling hypothesis, minvar rho²*NB/beta is lower-cost comparison, neither implemented
strongest_candidate.event: Within current native BTC episode, SOL-opposite close first-passage ladder frozen from calibration1D:1.040878%,2.423763%,4.224761%. Proportional pair reductions at TP1 and full losing-leg retirement at TP2 remain conditional proposals, not tested fill/cash transitions. Require net whole reduced slice positive after known entry costs+estimated executable exit costs+extra friction buffer; otherwise do not call paired loss compensation profitable. No blind EMA-flip close-both.
strongest_candidate.BTC_constraint: Original entry calendar/direction/size rules and next-entry NETTING boundary dominate. Never promise retain old BTC past required next opposite entry. Native BTC-entry path diagnostics stop at actual last exit.
strongest_candidate.validation: Calibration SOL TP1 46/57 hits,conditional pair net median +.153868%; holdout30/48,+.126960%,18/30 pair-net-positive. Factor-neutral1D BTC TP triggers median negative atall3 OOSlevels. Conditional signal only; nonhits, serial transitions, BE/rearm, funding, margin and originalSOL alpha interactions not simulated.
strongest_candidate.break_even: After TP1 BE must include actual cost basis, realized fees, future exit fee, funding and slippage allowance per retained leg; moving raw stop to entry is not BE. No net BE/DD guarantee.
